prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable single “best” without comparing bids and checking recent work. **Crown Roofing & Waterproofing** looks like a reasonable company to include on your shortlist: it says it serves Miami-Dade and uses Miami-Dade NOA-approved materials. **Duke Contractors** is another option; its search listing provides Florida license number **CCC1325931** and says it installs NOA-approved systems.

Before choosing, get at least three written estimates and verify each contractor’s active Florida license and insurance. Ask for the exact product approvals and installation details for your roof—not just a general “hurricane-rated” claim—and confirm the permit, inspections, warranty, and who will perform the work. In Miami-Dade, the complete roof assembly and installation must meet the applicable High-Velocity Hurricane Zone requirements.
